title: Trump Pardons Hedge Fund Felon
description_medium: Trump granted a pardon to a prominent hedge fund manager who had been convicted of securities fraud and financial crimes, adding to a pattern of clemency for white-collar criminals with connections to Republican donors. The pardon came after the individual's associates had donated to Trump-affiliated PACs. Ethics watchdogs noted the transaction appeared to fit a pattern of pardons-for-pay, though no formal quid pro quo could be proven. The pardon was issued with no public explanation.
